scope: Current backend core and Admin business mutation review; PostgreSQL/TypeORM adaptation of UniFlow
regressions: concurrent cross-admin demotions and suspensions
count and rows share a repeatable-read snapshot across a concurrent insert
invalid pagination and unknown query fields rejected by all six list endpoints
category UPDATE response and audit target/metadata are correct
deleting a missing category returns 404
audit failure rolls back the domain write
seed UUID syntax matches route and filter validation
database error details stay private and resource-neutral
category import preview writes neither categories nor audit; commit revalidates all rows
import rejects duplicate/unknown/invalid fields and persists all rows with per-row audit
batch deletion refuses referenced or missing categories without partial writes
batch curation serializes reversed ID batches across authors; repeated state changes no rows or revisions
second-row audit failure rolls back earlier import, deletion and curation statements
batch routes enforce administrator access, UUID uniqueness, reason and a 100 item limit
document and moderation decisions reject a stale administrator identity after role/active state changes
central moderation and plan audit records share the write transaction; audit failure rolls back all journals
concurrent plan updates serialize with accurate previous/current metadata
protected resource create/grant/revoke/delete roll back on audit failure and reject stale admin ownership bypass
generic template admin update/delete/restore writes recheck authority under transaction lock
active admins retain cleanup access to a protected resource after its owner is soft-deleted

runtime.databaseCheckScope: Migration journal checksums and row counts; this is not a comparison of every row content.

gitPolicy: No staging, reset, commit or push commands executed for this task. Existing staged work was preserved.
